channel.title: Touchline Sport
channel.description: Independent football news and analysis from Touchline Sport, covering Irish football, tactics, club strategy, recruitment and the business of the game.

item.title: Michael Noonan Set for Nottingham Forest Move From Shamrock Rovers
item.description: The 18-year-old could leave for compensation just months after Rovers accepted a €1.8 million bid from Hoffenheim.

item.title: Sligo Rovers: Can Fan Ownership Still Compete?
item.description: The Bit O’Red have the history, the support and the structure. What they may not have is the same access to capital as everyone else.

item.title: Liam Delap Leaves Door Open to Republic of Ireland Switch
item.description: Nottingham Forest striker tells Shay Given “I don’t know” when asked about playing for Ireland after scoring his first goal for the club.

item.title: FAI Opens Investigation Into Shamrock Rovers Over Noonan Transfers
item.description: FIFA referred agency agreements involving Michael and Alex Noonan back to the FAI for examination under third-party ownership rules.

item.title: St Patrick’s Athletic 2-0 Shamrock Rovers: Ryan Sheridan Shines at 17
item.description: Stephen Kenny’s side cut the Premier Division gap to three points as Sheridan impressed on his first league start.

item.title: Inside Cesc Fàbregas’ Como Game Model
item.description: How Como bait the press, manufacture the free player and use possession to keep asking defenders questions they don’t really want to answer.

item.title: Chelsea’s Transfer Machine: Will The New Model Finally Work In 2026?
item.description: Chelsea are still buying and selling at a ridiculous rate. In 2026, the question is whether all that churn is finally building a proper team.

item.title: Braywatch: The Seaside Club Bringing Young Talent Back to Life
item.description: Bray were once a proper Premier Division nuisance. Their route back now runs through teenagers, second chances and a ground where young players are trusted early.

item.title: Football Needs More Boredom
item.description: Why the modern game is addicted to instant reaction, hot takes and permanent crisis

item.title: Who Are Sabah FK? Meet Manchester United’s Champions League Wildcard
item.description: They were founded in 2017, have already dethroned Qarabağ and scored more goals than anyone in Champions League qualifying. Now Old Trafford is next.

item.title: Grow Your Own: Why LOI Clubs Must Back The Academy
item.description: The League of Ireland is finally making serious money from young players. If that’s where the game is heading, why aren’t more clubs spending now to produce the next Mason Melia?

item.title: Aldershot Town's Complete Rebuild: 21 Signings, 25 Departures
item.description: Most clubs call five or six new players a rebuild. Scott Davies arrived at Aldershot Town and found himself replacing practically everyone except the ground keeper.
